Independent Committee in relation to the  
Fire at Wang Fuk Court in Tai Po  

2nd Witness Statement of KEUNG Sai-ming  

I, KEUNG Sai-ming, of Licensing and Certification Command, Fire Services Department, 5th Floor, South Wing, Fire Services Headquarters Building, 1 Hong Chong Road, Tsim Sha Tsui East, Kowloon, do say as follows:-  

1. I am the same KEUNG Sai-ming who gave a witness statement dated 16 January 2026 (“my 1st Witness Statement”) to the Independent Committee (“Committee”) in relation to the fire at Wang Fuk Court in Tai Po.  

2. I make this 2nd Witness Statement pursuant to Request 4 of the Committee as set out in a letter from Messrs. Lo & Lo, Solicitors for the Committee, to the FSD dated 4 February 2026 in which specific questions were raised in paragraphs 1 to 10 and 16 (“Questions”). Save where otherwise appears, the facts deposed hereto are within my personal knowledge or are derived from office files and records and sources to which I have access and are true to the best of my knowledge, information and belief. Save as otherwise specified, this Witness Statement adopts the same abbreviations and nomenclature as in the 4 February Letter.  

3. This Witness Statement addresses Questions 4 and 5 of the 4 February Letter. Other Questions which are within FSD’s purview will be addressed in the witness statements of other relevant officers of FSD to the Committee.
